run_kuka_ik_simulation: run the pybullet kuka robot inverse kinematics simulation with cube objects in GUI mode
load_urdf_models: load URDF robot and object models into the pybullet physics simulation environment
calculate_inverse_kinematics: calculate inverse kinematics joint poses for the kuka robot end effector target position
set_joint_motor_control: set joint motor control with position control mode and target positions for each joint
get_link_state: get the link state and end effector pose of the kuka robot arm
